d: The landscape: L'Hochstoff. Largo piazzale emblazono da piedi. To the left is the house of Stromminger; to the right is the scattered alpine landscape of houses and pine trees. At the bottom of the other houses of the Hochstoff in the middle of which winding passes the road; then, higher, a bridge that joins two gigantic rocks dominant the deep abyss where the Ache flows. At the end of the bridge a large crucifix before which hangs a lamp. A winding path, for curves now sweet, now rough, traced between the boulders that jagged it, rises high, now disappearing, now suddenly appearing, and gets lost among the daring inequalities of the landscape. In the last bottom is the very high peaks of the Murzoll and Similaun covered with snow. It is the Vespro.

The landscape: the square of Sölden. At the bottom of the church which is accessed by a large stairway. From one side to the other, cross-country, run stripes of colorful canvas that cover the square in part (the part reserved for public dances). The inn of the Eagle is on the right. The windows, the door, the tables, the benches, everything is covered and adorned with froggy branches and flowers. Even from the windows and the balconies hang drapes in colors, fronds, garlands. It is all a country dressed as a feast! It is the Corpus Domini. The square is crowded by People; who goes and who comes; who gives himself to the discourse; who greets and passes; who laughs; who keeps himself in the crocchi. All the various and picturesque customs of Tyrol live and move in the small square. Here, the Pedon of Schnals already sitting in front of a huge cup of beer, in the middle of a crocchio di Giotti, drinking, bideell, sometimes,

The landscape: The Hochstoff. The scene is divided. On the right the house of the Stromminger (Wally time); on the front the inside of the bedroom of the Wally. On the other side a street of the Hochstoff flanked on the left by houses. From the street you enter the room of the Wally by a small door. Two windows stand on the sides of this door. On the extreme horizon, as in the first act, but from a different point of view, the Murzoll, the Similaun. The bridge remains much closer to the spectators, and the path that leads you is only a continuation of the street of the Hochstoff. It falls in the evening. In front of the crucifix the lamp is lit.

On the Murzoll. Tired, not far from his hut stood one day Wally sitting on one of the highest peaks of the Murzoll. The scene that surrounded it resembled in the sad and bruised December a cemetery scattered with snow mounds, with the branches bizarrely shaped by the ice in crosses, with the bushes of alpine flowers transformed into transparent and white tombs like the marble. Under his feet stretched the sea of ice, desolate, endless, with its greenish reflections and its stiff waves that extended to the other side of the mountain. The horizon with his countless chains of mountains was wrapped in the fantastic vapors of the deserved. The Similaun, next to Wally, was caressed by a small cloud, and the girl, leaning her head in her hands, followed its waves mechanically.
